Humor settings

These settings are for Humor only. News keeps its own.

One request on each line. Jokes sets where the jokes play. Romance adds couples: a loving post, the partner's reply, and what others said, marked 恋愛 in the corner. Travel adds what people said at famous places, marked 観光. Each comment shows its short part first, then the whole comment. The number of items comes from Items under the video. Leave the lineup empty for a mix of all genres.

Sensitive posts play at the start: couples' talk in Romance may be suggestive or sexual; jokes and places stay clean. Light Hide sensitive posts to leave them out everywhere. Violence and hard news such as deaths, accidents, disasters, illness, bullying and discrimination never play.

Add an account to load funny replies to its posts. Press Add again for another account. Press a name to remove it.
